description: Holding pen for Life Situation Tags that don't yet have ≥2 strong story matches in the seed map. Drafts are NOT loaded by the compliance test or the CLI. A draft graduates to assets/stories/life_situation_tags_registry.json once a second strong story carries it. If a draft never graduates after 2-3 batches, kill it.

drafts.description: I lost or damaged something that belonged to someone else. Panic, responsibility, embarrassment, hope of restoration.
drafts.note: Load-bearing motif for the v1 motivating example (Borrowed Axe → 1196). Promote when a second clear borrowed-and-lost story enters the corpus. Until then, 1196 is reachable via let_someone_down + restoration_after_loss.

drafts.description: Making things right materially after a wrong — paying back, returning, replacing. Distinct from forgiveness because the action is restorative, not relational.
drafts.note: Zacchaeus only. Watch for Onesimus (Philemon) or others to graduate.

drafts.description: I want to be different — and I'm doing something visible about it.
drafts.note: Zacchaeus only. Could graduate with Saul/Paul conversion arc once tagged.

drafts.description: The thing I asked for came. The story sits after the answer, in the keeping of vows or in joy.
drafts.note: Hannah-dedicates-Samuel only. Could graduate via Sarah's joy or Elizabeth + John the Baptist.

drafts.description: I couldn't get there myself; people who loved me brought me. Distinct from quiet_provision because the carriers are personally known.
drafts.note: Paralytic through roof only. Watch for other friend-mediated healings.

drafts.description: Asking again, louder, refusing to be hushed when the crowd wants me quiet.
drafts.note: Blind Bartimaeus only. Persistent widow parable would graduate this if added.

drafts.description: I was caught in the act, and the verdict went the other way. Distinct from forgiveness_received because the wrong is undeniable and public.
drafts.note: Woman caught in adultery only. Could graduate via the thief on the cross.

drafts.description: I gave something extravagant out of love and was told it was foolish or wasteful.
drafts.note: Woman anoints Jesus's feet only. Could graduate via the widow's two mites.

drafts.description: Wanting to stop existing — said plainly, not metaphorically. The honest words are part of the story.
drafts.note: Elijah under juniper only. Could graduate via Jonah ('better for me to die') or Job. Sensitive tag — keep description grounded, do not route to general sadness.

drafts.description: Being asked to give from what you barely have, with the promise that the well won't go dry.
drafts.note: Elijah + widow of Zarephath only. Could graduate via the widow's mite or feeding-of-5000.

drafts.description: Stopping for someone who is not your problem — when others walked past.
drafts.note: Good Samaritan only. Could graduate via Onesiphorus or hospitality stories.

drafts.description: A decision point where doing right has real consequences and there is no safe option. The story turns on the moment of choosing.
drafts.note: Moved from registry 2026-06-19 — orphaned when 800-series promotion retired 819 (Queen Esther). Currently 1 story carries this tag; promote back to registry once a 2nd strong story is tagged.

drafts.description: Confronting a ruler, authority, or institution with what they don't want to hear. Risk is asymmetric — they hold the power.
drafts.note: Moved from registry 2026-06-19 — orphaned when 800-series promotion retired 819 (Queen Esther). Currently 1 story carries this tag; promote back to registry once a 2nd strong story is tagged.
